title: SFX -- world star-gutter (a light dies, variant)
_note: Variant of the star-gutter snuff. Sparser and colder than -a: a single hollow pulse50 note that flickers (two failing pulses) then collapses in a down-glide and dies, with a low noise sink under it. More 'flicker-flicker-gone' than -a's one long slide - the last guttering of a candle before the dark. Down, hollow, unresolved, no sparkle. ~0.5s. Render --tail 0.18.
